invariants.rationale: The result is a boolean indicating commit success or failure.
The instantTime parameter is expected to be non-null as it identifies the commit instant.
The list of write statuses is expected to be non-null when commit is called.
The commitActionType string is expected to be non-null since it identifies the type of commit action.
The partitionToReplacedFileIds map is expected to be non-null to represent replaced file information during commit.
